title: Excellent guide and driver
text: Excellent service from Miguel, communicative the whole time, with some concern about his way of driving and although he drives fast, he does it with caution, respect on the road, perhaps some are not used to it, but this helped a lot with the travel between places and the return, great mastery of driving. Very attentive at all times.
author: borispK2790QT

title: Excellent experience
text: A very beautiful experience! We visited three beautiful medieval villages and we loved the tour. The guide was excellent, very kind, punctual, and explained everything to us in great detail, making the visit very interesting and entertaining. The guide is also a very good driver. We enjoyed the tour very much and we recommend it without a doubt!
author: carolinapG3686OL

title: A great one-day tour
text: The tour is excellent; you get to discover beautiful medieval villages. Our guide, Miguel, was outstanding—punctual, friendly, fun, and a very good driver. He possesses deep knowledge of the history of the villages we visited and is truly passionate about it. We highly recommend both the tour and the guide.
